subject: Urgent: privacy clause exception & DPA execution timeline
messages:
From: Sara White <sara.white@finledger.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@finledger.com, amy.cho@finledger.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood DPA redlines — timeline for execution

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our legal and procurement teams reviewed the DPA and attached a set of redlines (attached PDF + subprocessor list). Two items are blocking our signature:

1) A requirement that Redwood use customer-managed KMS for token encryption — our security policy requires proof of key custody separation for financial data.
2) Clarification on cross-border transfers to EU-owned GPUs and a list of subprocessors with locations.

Procurement is hoping to close by Friday (5/14) to meet our quarter-end go-live. Is there a path for a limited exception or an exec sign-off that can keep the timeline? If you can route the redlines to the right contacts internally and let me know the earliest decision point that would be great.

Attachments: FinLedger_DPA_redlines_v3.pdf, FinLedger_subprocessors_list_20270510.xlsx

Best,
Sara White
Senior Counsel, FinLedger Inc
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: sara.white@finledger.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA redlines — timeline for execution

Sara — thanks for sending this over and for the clear deadline. I've looped in our privacy and legal leads (Rishi) and our sales director (Marissa) to expedite. Quick summary of where we stand internally:

- KMS: Our standard hosted offering uses Redwood-managed encryption keys. We do offer a Private deployment option for customer-managed KMS, but that is typically a project-level change that needs procurement and infra sign-off (lead time > 2 weeks). Rishi, is there any short-term exception we can offer?
- Subprocessors: we will provide a full location breakdown and can commit to notifying FinLedger of changes per the DPA.

We understand the timeline pressure. If possible, can you indicate whether a temporary operational control (e.g., restricting EU-hosted inference for FinLedger until a Private deployment is in place) would be acceptable while we finalize the KMS path? That might let both teams move to DocuSign for signature on the rest of the DPA.

I will follow up internally and escalate the KMS ask as an exception request.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive — Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: exec_exception_request_form.pdf (template)]
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood DPA redlines — KMS exception?

Forwarding FinLedger's redlines. Quick legal note: our baseline policy does not permit hosted API customers to require customer-managed KMS due to operational complexity and data residency implications. A handful of enterprise accounts with Reserved/Dedicated or Private deployments have bespoke KMS arrangements but these are handled under a separate SOW.

Options to propose to the customer:
- Offer a conditional sign-off on the DPA with an operational mitigation: restrict inference region to US-only nodes (no EU cross-border) and provide monthly audit log exports until Private/KMS is provisioned.
- Offer Dedicated capacity with a KMS add-on (but will affect pricing and lead time).
- Exec exception: Legal + Product need to sign off. This requires an internal exception form and VP approval; timeline is 3-5 business days if we prioritize.

If the customer needs DocuSign today for commercial approval, we can proceed on the DPA minus the KMS clause and include an explicit implementation timeline in the SOW. That does carry residual risk; we should document it.

Rishi
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: sara.white@finledger.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA redlines — timeline for execution

Looping in commercial: Stephanie, can you ask FinLedger whether a staged approach would be acceptable — sign DPA now with the operational restriction Rishi suggested and enumerate a 30-day milestone in the SOW for Private/Dedicated options? If they push back on any wording that exposes us to KMS obligation in hosted, we should not accept it.

Sara — quick Q for clarity: is FinLedger willing to accept a contractual commitment to a technical restriction (no EU inference) + a documented plan for KMS provision in the SOW, or do you need the KMS clause in the DPA itself to satisfy your internal auditors? If it's the latter, we'll need an exec exception and a slightly longer sign timeline.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Sara White <sara.white@finledger.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@finledger.com, amy.cho@finledger.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA redlines — timeline for execution

Thanks for the quick responses. FinLedger's auditors will accept a staged approach only if the DPA includes: (a) explicit language committing Redwood to deploy customer-managed KMS within 30 days of signature OR (b) an exec-level exception approving the hosted KMS approach with documented compensating controls. We prefer (b) if that accelerates signing.

Procurement has sign-off to execute on 5/14 if we get legal confirmation today. If Redwood wants to proceed with option (a) we will need to see a timeline and milestones in the SOW and a firm resource commitment.

Please advise — we have internal go-live planning contingent on this start date.

Best,
Sara White
Senior Counsel, FinLedger Inc
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: sara.white@finledger.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA redlines — timeline for execution

Sara — quick update and ask for alignment:

- Rishi has submitted the exec exception request and the form is attached. Our legal / product VP will review this morning. Estimated decision window is 24–72 hours.
- To avoid blocking procurement on Friday, we can prepare a DocuSign envelope that excludes the KMS-specific redline and includes an addendum clause: "Customer and Redwood agree a documented implementation plan for customer-managed KMS within 30 days of DPA signature or an approved exec exception will be recorded." That would allow commercial close while preserving the implementation commitment.

Can FinLedger confirm if DocuSign today on that basis is acceptable, or if you require the full redline to be in the executed DPA? If you confirm the DocuSign path, we will: (1) send updated DPA for signature without the KMS obligation, (2) create a tracked SOW/implementation plan, and (3) expedite the exec exception in parallel.

Thanks for flexibility — we want to keep to your timeline if we can.

Regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive — Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
